source.section: Form 1040ME lines 14-20 (PDF pp.1-2); line 17 Maine Standard Deduction Chart and Worksheet for Standard / Itemized Deductions lines 1-8 (booklet PDF p.5); line 13 table and line 18 (PDF p.5); Worksheet for Phaseout of Personal Exemption Deduction Amount lines 1-8 (booklet PDF p.6); 2025 Tax Rate Schedules (PDF p.13). worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 300,000.00 + wages (person 1) 150,100.00 = 450,100.00. Federal taxable income = 450,100.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction = 418,600.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 1040ME, married filing jointly: line 14 federal AGI 450,100.00. Schedule 1A line 1 (PDF p.7) other-state municipal bond interest 0.00; Schedule 1A total = line 15a 0.00. Schedule 1S line 3 (PDF p.7) taxable Social Security 0.00 + railroad retirement 0.00 = 0.00. Schedule 1S line 4 pension income deduction 0.00 (no eligible pension income). Schedule 1S line 27 total subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 = line 15b 0.00. Line 16 Maine AGI = 450,100.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 450,100.00. Line 17 (person 0 born 1970-01-20 is 55 at December 31, 2025; person 1 born 1972-05-05 is 53 at December 31, 2025; 0 box(es)): Worksheet for Standard/Itemized Deductions (PDF p.5): line 1 450,100.00; line 2 200,050.00; line 3 250,050.00; line 4 150,000.00; line 5 = 1.667, one or more, so 1.0000; line 6 chart amount 30,000.00; line 7 = 30,000.00 x 1.0000 = 30,000.00; line 8 = 0.00. Projection (share kept 1 - 1.0000 = 0.0000): base 30,000.00 x 0.0000 = 0.00, the same. Line 17 = 0.00. Line 13 = 2; Worksheet for Phaseout of Personal Exemption Deduction Amount (PDF p.6): line 1 450,100.00; line 2 400,100.00; line 3 50,000.00; line 4 125,000.00; line 5 = 0.4, entered to four decimals as 0.4000; line 6 = 2 x 5,150.00 = 10,300.00; line 7 = 10,300.00 x 0.4000 = 4,120.00; line 8 = 6,180.00. Projection: 10,300.00 x (1 - 0.4000) = 6,180.00, the same. Line 18 = 6,180.00. Line 19 taxable income = 450,100.00 - 0.00 - 6,180.00 = 443,920.00. Line 20 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.13): 5.8% x (53,600.00 - 0.00) = 3,108.80 + 6.75% x (126,900.00 - 53,600.00) = 4,947.75 + 7.15% x (443,920.00 - 126,900.00) = 22,666.93 = 30,723.48. The printed schedule (PDF p.13) with its whole-dollar constant 8,057.00 gives 30,723.93; expected keeps the bracket tax computed in full. Line 23 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 24 Maine income tax 30,723.48.
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rate schedules as numbers. The booklet's table taxes 100-dollar rows and the printed schedule constants are rounded to dollars.
